quest.title: Glaze Domain, Multum in Parvo
quest.description: After touching the bottle, you really do enter a Domain, but the owner is nowhere to be seen. If you want to find the sender of the "Magic Invite," you'll need to go deep into the Domain...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's a big ball of water...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I wonder what it feels like? Can I touch it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so big that we could probably pass straight through it!

choices.text: And that was the last we ever heard from Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wah, that's so scary! Stop giving Paimon the heebie-jeebies!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Let's not touch it for now. We still don't know enough about our environment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we can't just do nothing at all, because then... nothing at all will happen.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmm... I have a feeling that this could be the core that sustains this entire bottle-domain.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: In which case the moment we touch it, this place will instantly revert to its original size... with all of us still inside.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yikes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, Paimon won't touch it, geez!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Kaeya... Are we really gonna get squished inside a bottle?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Of course not, Klee. I'm sure the real core of this domain is hidden away in a very safe place.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Somewhere like... over there, for example.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: (Ah! I was so nervous that I didn't notice that big wheel at all!)

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Wait! Who goes there!
Gurgle!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's... It's the waterball monster! Ah, the waterball monster is real!
Gurgle...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: It doesn't seem hostile... In fact, don't you think it looks happy to see us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Really? Uh, you're sure it's not gonna gobble up Paimon whole?
Gurgle...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't think it's hungry! Are you, Water Droplet?

response.speaker: Water Droplet
response.text: Gurgle...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh dear. I don't know about anyone else, but I'm not understanding a word of this.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Wait, don't go! Wait for us!

response.speaker: Water Droplet
response.text: Gurgle...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Why'd it stop?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Maybe it can understand us after all?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, I get it now! It's leading the way for us — just like the cats in Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Like the cats...? How so?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: When you're walking around in Mondstadt city, sometimes a cat will show up on the side of the road.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It'll walk ahead of you for a while, and if you're curious enough to follow it, you'll soon find yourself in front of a fine establishment called:

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Cat's Tail!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Exactly. So let's see where this Water Droplet takes us. It could be interesting.

choices.text: Watch out, you might get gobbled up by the water-ball monster...

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, another strange contraption... And there's a weird-looking wall over there.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: This kinda looks like that ball of water we saw earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Did the Water Droplet bring us here because it wants our help with something?

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: What? Your friend is trapped in the wall!?

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Don't be sad, Water Droplet! We're here now, we'll save your friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You bet! But, how're we gonna save them? Do we have to break down this wall somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nope, we can't do that! No breaking the wall.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do we need to find a key of some sort, then?

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh no! Where'd it go?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Look, the device has lit up. And it's projecting images onto the wall.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: A two-dimensional space... with objects of the same composition as the device nested inside...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! What Kaeya said! And that's where its friend is.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But how exactly do we enter the image on the wall?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Maybe... we just copy what the Water Droplet did?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... But what does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hold on, I think Klee's onto something.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Since the Water Droplet appears to be the key that activated the mechanism, we may be able to follow it inside simply by touching the device.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The principle is no different than how we entered this bottle domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fair enough... Okay, deep breath, then head in!

talks.objective: Enter the stone wall and save the Water Droplet's friend

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was flat as a pancake in there, but as soon as it came out, it turned all plump and round...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, guess it makes sense that the Water Droplet's friend is also a Water Droplet.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Aw, and they both do the same thing to show they're happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Water Droplet number two ran off...

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #It's saying thank you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight, that was a huuuuge help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how do you feel after entering that two-dimensional space? Any... physical side effects?

choices.text: No, I feel the same as ever...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure seem fine to Paimon.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Well, I'm just glad that you're okay.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good thing Eula's here to look out for everyone... Can't say the same for you though, Kaeya. You were pretty quick to send the Traveler inside...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #Hey now, I only suggested that because I was confident that {NICKNAME} would be fine.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Water Droplet, is there anyone else here besides you and your friend?

response.speaker: Water Droplet
response.text: Gurgle?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep, y'know, anyone who looks like me or my friends.

response.speaker: Water Droplet
response.text: Gurgle!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it ran off again... Hopefully this is a good sign.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Amazing... C'mon, let's follow it!

choices.text: Ah, the pain! I've been squished flat like a Traveler pizza!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, quit while you're behind. You're clearly fine.

talks.objective: Go to the small town in the middle of the Domain

dialogues.text: Idyia, the situation is now critical. Our window of opportunity to fix this is rapidly closing.
I'm sure you've noticed just how much things have deteriorated in recent days.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: B—But, even so...
This is your home. Are you really going to let everything fall to pieces?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I... Well, I live here, but it doesn't actually belong to me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon knows that voice...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Definitely sounds like someone we know.
Anyone else who comes into this domain in the future will take one look at the ruins before them and conclude that this place was abandoned years ago.
But just imagine how different things could be if you maintained this domain in perfect condition. Whoever sets foot inside would witness a magical wonderland...
How miraculous it would feel to them to find such unimaginable beauty in the middle of a lifeless desert.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're right, General, truly, but—

dialogues.speaker: General Sangonomiya?
dialogues.text: Act now, while you still can. You have to stand up to this, and break free from your despair.

dialogues.speaker: General Sangonomiya?
dialogues.text: The most important thing is to have no regrets in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Huh... Heh, well... No one CHOOSES to have regrets, do they...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But I take your point... I'll try my best to stop running away.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But the question remains of where to begin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon's figured out who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Is it {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight's friend from a faraway land?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's a Divine Priestess...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: A divine priestess? What's that? Is it a kind of mage?

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: What are you doing here? Huh...? We have new visitors?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Greetings, everyone. This is the Veluriyam Mirage, and I'm the caretaker, Idyia...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry that you have to see this domain in its current state of disarray. We are actively working on repairs, and everything will be back to normal shortly! Um, I hope...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Greetings, everyone. I guess I should introduce myself, too—

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: It's all right, just leave the introductions to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: (Hmm? I kinda wanted to say hello in my own way... But no harm done, I guess I'll let her do the honors.)

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: This lady is a visitor to the domain, just like yourselves. She is a formidable military general.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Have any of you heard of Inazuma's "Onmyou Chamber"?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: The... what chamber?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Onmyou chamber. It's an elite training academy for gifted students of Onmyoudou. Practitioners are divided into four classes, A through D, and assigned the power of shikigami based on their mastery of the art...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Ah... Wait...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: This lady famously led the class D underdogs to victory against the class A favorites in the final mock-campaign before graduation, an astonishing feat that few in the history of the academy have ever achieved. Hence, "formidable general" is no exaggeration!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Isn't that right, General? Uh... What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, so the favorites were beaten by the... classy underdogs...? Paimon's not completely following...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Those all sound like tropes from some Inazuman light novels!)

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #That doesn't sound like the "Divine Priestess" {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: (Uh-oh, did she just get caught lying in front of someone she was trying to impress? Or... maybe she uses a different identity in her private life, and this is the first time her friends are learning about it...)

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: (Seems... kind of embarrassing, but also kinda cool... I guess having someone else to introduce you is a good way to make an impression...)

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: (Hmm, maybe I'd fit in better with everyone if I had a title, too?)

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Ahem... Some people call me a general, but it's just their way of showing respect. My actual name is Sangonomiya Kokomi.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh no... Sorry, my mistake, General... Uh, I mean... Miss Sangonomiya?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Call me whatever you like, Idyia. The only important thing about names is knowing who's who.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it now! It's like that story that Mom told me that time!

dialogues.speaker: Water Droplet
dialogues.text: Gurgle?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee can explain! So basically, in the story, a big group of people go on an adventure to Bottleland. One of them's called the "king," and some of them are called "knights"!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So Miss Sangonomiya must be the super smart one who solves all the problems in the story... Um... What's that one called again?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Perhaps a "sage"?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Indeed, wisdom is an important attribute found in military generals.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay, well I'll just call you that! Hehe, Miss General it is!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Fine by me. It sounds really cute, coming from you.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: (At least... cuter than my pen name, that's for sure...)

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Well then, how should I address the rest of you?

choices.text: Old friend for me... I hope!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe, how could I ever forget you? But what about these esteemed ladies and gentlemen accompanying you? I'd be delighted if you could introduce me to them, too.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Wait, Klee wants a title, too! Hmm... okay, got it. Klee wants to be a Mage! The kind that flies around everywhere. Da-da-da! WHOOSH!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Kaeya can be the "Master Thief," {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight can be, uh... the "Knight." And Paimon will be the "Fairy" who follows the Knight everywhere.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Master Thief, huh? I did like playing pirates as a child, so I suppose this is an apt role for me. And I must admit, the "Master" part is a nice touch.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hold on a second! Are you saying the position of "Knight" is now filled?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Eula can be the "Swordmaster," who can cut through anything and also gets to wear a super sparkly cape!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmph. That's more like it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And Collei can be, umm... the "Healer."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...If you wanna be the Knight, we can swap.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: No no, I don't mind, Healer is a great role! I just don't know if I'm qualified to be one...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Whenever I'm thinking of titles for myself, I usually imagine myself as an "adventurer" or "musician." I never thought I could be a Healer... I mean, it feels like it should be Master Tighnari's role, if anyone's...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Don't worry, Collei, you'll be the bestest healer ever! You don't talk much, but you're very kind. Just like the Healers in Mom's stories!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You'll do fine. I heard you're good with bandages. You can patch up a wound, can't you?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uhh... I can pitch a tent? Maybe you heard wrong... But I'll do my best! It's my first day filling in for Master Tighnari, but hopefully it's the first of many!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: This is a great idea... Once a new visitor arrives, they can assume a new identity... then add in some role-playing...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, we can't leave you out, Miss Idyia! Hmm... There are lots of characters in Mom's stories, but you don't remind me of any of them...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: That's perfectly okay! I already have a role here anyway, remember? I'm the caretaker.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I got it, I got it! This wasn't in any of the stories, but you can be the "Mascot!"

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Mascot...?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Klee, maybe you could think up an even better role for Miss Idyia?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: A mascot, you say... Isn't that a character that doesn't have to actually do anything, and sits around letting everyone else do all the important work? Incredible, you've seen right through me...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Sounds like the idea of being lazy is pretty exciting to her...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The Mascot serves to maintain troop morale, Idyia. Don't underestimate your role.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Ah, alright. I'll be the Mascot, then.

response.speaker: Water Droplet
response.text: Gurgle?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: That's right. Thank you for bringing these new friends here safely. You can go off and play now.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Thanks, Water Droplet! See ya!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Hmm, Water Droplet? Is that your pet name for it? Haha, I suppose it's as accurate a nickname as any.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: We keep getting sidetracked... but I believe you were saying something about being in a difficult predicament. Is something wrong with the Veluriyam Mirage?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Ah yes, about that... I'm afraid the entire domain has recently sustained some significant damage...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: It was as if... the whole world was suddenly flipped upside down. A few components went missing from the core, which sustains the domain, and the impact cascaded out from there.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Needless to say, many things in the Veluriyam Mirage have now stopped working...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Just days after I agreed to let my friend's daughter come and visit, too. When she gets here, and sees the state this place is in—

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, so you're Mom's friend? Hi, Aunty Desert, I'm Klee! Here, I brought the Magic Invite — see?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Huh? Wait, so you're... you're...!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Look how dilated her pupils are... She must be very surprised.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yeah, and not in a good way...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mom's the one who sent me here! She's the strongest mage ever. She said that her friend lives in the desert — you live in the desert, so that must be you! Right, Aunty Desert?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Ah, I see. So being a mage runs in the family.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Aaaah!!!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: You're... you're Alice's daughter!? Oh, I just want the ground to swallow me up right now... Wait, that's it! I'll hide myself away in the core of the domain! Hide there until this all blows over. See you all in a hundred years!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Idyia's really going through it! She's like a shriveled little forest fungus, hanging its head in shame!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Collei? That's a harsh analogy, where'd all that come from?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Don't worry, Aunty Desert, Klee's here to help you! And all my friends will help, too! Just take a deep breath, then another deep breath, and all your worries will fly away!

choices.text: Klee's right. Many hands make light work...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, don't you worry — {M#Sir}{F#Lady} Fixalot over here has a good track record with this kind of thing!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Well, I'm useless... but it looks like that won't matter with all you capable people around. Fantastic!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't put yourself down, Idyia, you're great too!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Thanks for your encouragement... Anyway, for the time being, please talk amongst yourselves.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: That'll give me some time to think things through, and maybe make a start on... um, delegating...

choices.text: As a Knight, it shall be my honor to render my assistance...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Hi Miss General! {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight says that you're from Watatsumi Island...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: What's it like there? There must be loooads of fish, right?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wait! You look kinda like a mermaid. Are there fish in your family?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Sorry to disappoint you, Miss Mage, but I'm just an ordinary human.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I have lots of great stories about Watatsumi Island, though. C'mon, let's enjoy the scenery while I tell you all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Hmm? Who else has visited the Veluriyam Mirage recently? There was someone from the Akademiya who came not long ago... a Kshahrewar scholar. Blond hair, architect, I think?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: He was a huge help, and redesigned many of the buildings here. Although he was always grumbling to himself, he was extremely diligent in his work. Ah... What a kind person...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I could tell that was a sensitive soul, a lot like me... Ah! Sorry, please pretend you didn't hear that... Ahem! I'm of course a very strong and resilient person.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: After him, an aristocrat from Mondstadt showed up, then the Gen— I mean, Miss Sangonomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, everything here suddenly started changing before I'd had the chance to be a good host and show them around.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Do you know where the Mondstadt aristocrat is now?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...If I remember correctly, he headed north after the incident.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: It's a pity we're having all these issues... *sigh* If we could get everything working normally again, I could probably locate him in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Still, not to worry. There's nothing dangerous here.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Mm...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Feeling nervous, Collei? It's your first time as a guide, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh no, not at all. I'm just... still settling into the role, so I was thinking about how to talk more like Master Tighnari...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well, the easiest way to imitate someone is to start with their most common turns of phrase.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, okay. In that case... Ahem! "Put that mushroom down! Now! It's highly poisonous."

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: There you go. With just a few simple words, you've captured your master's personality perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Anyway, what about your role? Don't you mind being the "Master Thief"? It doesn't sound like you're one of the good guys...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Maybe not — until you factor in that I only steal from the enemy. I think that's enough to make me one of the good guys... don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... fair point, fair point...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Idyia, you got an update for us? We've all caught up with each other.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Very well. Then please allow me, Idyia, your Mascot, to explain exactly what's happened here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She's pretty happy with this Mascot role, huh...)

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Basically, this entire domain is powered by a device called the Central Hub, which you all saw earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But following a major incident, several key components from the Central Hub came loose and went flying.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...Four components, I believe, which has caused the Central Hub to stop turning.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ohhh, so that thing's supposed to spin?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Yes! It definitely shouldn't be frozen still like it is now! ...At least, that's not how it was when I first got here? Ugh, I've done such a terrible job of taking care of it, it's so embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, everything's gonna be okay. So, we need to fix the big wheel up there, and to do that we need to find the missing parts.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Right... I do know where one of the parts is. It landed not too far away.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But the rest all landed in different areas. I'm afraid you'll have to go and look for those...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Ahem! Now, as the caretaker and your mascot, I shall announce your respective adventure duties!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Umm... You can just be yourself if you want, no need to force the whole roleplaying thing...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...Oh, I see... Um, okay, so I was thinking that maybe Swordmaster Eula and Healer Collei could investigate the northern zone, if that's okay?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Fine by me. I was going to be looking for my cousin there anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'll be your backup, Eula. I know you usually team up with Amber, so I'll try my best to fill her shoes.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh? Well this'll be fun. Let's see if a forest ranger can outperform an outrider.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Master Thief Kaeya and Mage Klee, if you could earmark some time in your busy schedules to search the west zone...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Earmark? What does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It just means we mustn't forget to do it. Don't worry, we can handle that.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: #Finally, we have our General, Miss Sangonomiya, and our Knight, {NICKNAME}. If there's no objections, please come with me to retrieve the first component.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Alright. Well, if anyone finds anything, come back here and we'll regroup.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Please take care while you're out on the road, and look after each other... especially our little mage here.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: You got it! I'll take extra-special care of Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'll be on my best behavior.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Okay, we'll leave it there for now. You two, please follow me.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Wow... Spoken like a true knight.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe... Then for my part, my strategic mind is at your service.

talks.objective: Go to the first component's location
Keep heading towards the first component's location

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: All you need to do is touch the Streaming Projector and you'll enter the world of preprints...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Don't worry. It's not dangerous.

talks.objective: Keep heading towards the first component's location
Keep heading towards the first component's location
Keep heading towards the first component's location

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Okay, this is the spot.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Now, I'm sure you're both wondering: "But where's the component?"

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: "There's nothing here! Oh, where could it be..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's that lamp thingy, right? Water Droplet showed us how that works already.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Uh... yes, that's the one... There goes my big introduction.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Showing people the ropes is supposed to be my job... I can't believe I'm being shown up by a Hydro Eidolon...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Cheer up, Idyia. The Hydro Eidolon can give a basic demonstration of how to use things, but beyond that, it can't communicate...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: That's where you come in. Your descriptions can explain everything in full, vivid detail.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon forgot how persuasive Kokomi can be when she really wants to... Sometimes having a genius strategist around really comes in handy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Now I see how an eloquent speaker can persuade others to not only agree with them, but do things for them...)

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Oh, if you put it that way... Well then, just pretend like you've never seen it before, and I'll tell you all about it!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: This is called the Streaming Projector. Everything here in the Veluriyam Mirage was made using this device...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: All you need to do is place an item in the Projector, and you can construct a corresponding item based on the shape of the original and your imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...At least, I think that's what it used to do. With the domain in its current state, only its most basic functions are still operable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Basic functions... like shining light?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Okay, not quite that basic... At the moment, it's only able to show two-dimensional objects. I call them "preprints."

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Think of it like a sort of draft or blueprint, or something.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: So you're saying, the component fell into the preprints?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Yes, exactly. I'll leave you to go in and physically retrieve it, while I... Uh, I'll be out here rooting for you by... by doing a motivational dance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: ...No. Sorry. I feel like I have two left feet when I try to dance. I guess I'll just... find a place nearby to sit and wait patiently for you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, come on, cheer up. We'll handle everything from here!

talks.objective: Enter the preprint and get the component

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this thing, anyway? Some kind of gear?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And why's it so small? It doesn't look like it belongs in that huge wheel...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: It's hard to explain, but I assure you that it's definitely one of the components.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: So that leaves three more components missing...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Every journey begins with a first step. I think we're off to a good start, and things should keep going smoothly from here.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Y—You really think so?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, trust the General!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I suppose you're right... she did manage to defeat class A at the Onmyou chamber, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Um... You, uh, don't need to keep bringing that up!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for all your help.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I'll take this and start trying to repair the Central Hub. You two may as well head back to town.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why am I so clumsy? Once again, I was no help at all... The least I can do is try and handle the actual repairs.

talks.objective: Return to the Silver Bottle Courtyard

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Kokomi?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I'm just a little confused... You mentioned that the Water Droplet showed you how to use the projector?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Can you tell me a little bit more about that? I'm so curious to know what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, sure!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Kokomi everything that happened earlier with Water Droplet.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! The wheel is spinning now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, and now it's stopped again. Well, that didn't last long...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It also wasn't spinning at the right speed. Before the incident, it spun much faster than that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you saw it back when it was still working?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Yes. I arrived here a little earlier than the rest of you. But the incident took place not long after I entered.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Like Idyia said, it felt like the world was "flipped upside down"... I don't know how else to describe it... and I certainly don't want to experience it again.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's no use... Seems it won't run until all the missing components are returned.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: For a moment there, when it started turning, I got excited... I thought that maybe the hub can work just fine without the other three...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Wishful thinking is only going to lead to disappointment, Idyia. Let's stick to the plan, we'll get there.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Hey, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight and Miss General are here! Oh, and our mascot!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You beat us! I was sure we were gonna be the first ones back!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey. How'd it go?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha. Impressive. I doubt you'd find many other knights of such caliber even among the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: How about our Master Thief and Mage? Did you find anything?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: You bet! We made a huuuge discovery!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The place we were trying to get to was blocked off. We couldn't see anything past it, and there was no way around.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But then, just now, a huge canyon appeared outta nowhere... so we hurried back here!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It appeared just now?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Come and see, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight! Let's go on a canyon adventure!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: To the canyon!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I'll sit this one out. I'm beat after trying to make those repairs... I need to take a break.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Miss General, you should come, too! You can hide behind me and give me smart advice while I protect you!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Wonderful. It would be an honor to serve as adviser for our young mage.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hee-hee, let's go!!!

choices.text: Where a knight's sword goes, victory soon follows!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It went this way, right? Hope we haven't lost it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did the Water Droplet go into that cave?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow, another Water Droplet just came out from the wall...

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I remember seeing it just behind the Central Hub...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: ...So how come you didn't bring it back when you first saw it?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I'd have been more than happy to, if this one component was enough to fix the whole domain.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But with three other components to find... I suddenly felt overwhelmed by how much work needed doing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon kinda gets that... Taking the first step is always the hardest part.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like the component is in here...
